description: A tender deep infection of a hair follicle and surrounding tissue, commonly called a boil.
causes: Usually bacterial infection of a hair follicle, commonly Staphylococcus aureus

appearance.general: A tender red or inflamed nodule that may become fluctuant and develop a central pustule.

warning_signs: Rapidly spreading redness, fever, severe pain, or lesions near the eye or nose require medical assessment.
general_first_aid: Keep the area clean and protected.
Do not squeeze or puncture the lesion.
prevention: Good skin hygiene and avoidance of sharing personal towels or razors.
